title: EtaleResolutionSectionCanonicalData
statement: For every scheme $X$, abelian sheaf $G$ on its small etale site, and injective resolution $I$ of $G$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], there is a normalized comparison for $I$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. This assertion involves one resolution on one scheme and no morphism between schemes, no chain lift, and no naturality conclusion.

source.place: Tag 0A50, sections of an injective resolution; Tag 03F3 (2), localization; Read the corresponding Stacks tag pages; cocycle expansion of the parent proof, written by W3.

proof.text: Apply the proved private represented_resolution lemma to evaluation at the terminal etale object, represented by the constant integer sheaf through the constant-sheaf adjunction and evaluation at 1. The helper maps cycles by extMk, proves that its kernel is precisely the boundaries using extMk_eq_zero_iff in positive degrees and the vanishing degree minus one in degree zero, and descends along the cokernel homology projection. extMk_surjective proves surjectivity. Thus the resulting additive equivalence has the required value on every representing cocycle.

Apply the same represented_resolution lemma to evaluation at each open etale object, represented by the free abelian sheaf using sectionsEquiv and sectionsEquiv_naturality. Compose its additive equivalence with AddEquiv.ofBijective of etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap using etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap_bijective. The open cocycle formula follows by the helper normalization and application of this independently defined map. Assemble the degreewise equivalences and the two formulas into ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0A50 and 03F3; resolution computation via Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extMk, extMk_eq_zero_iff, extMk_surjective and ShortComplex.descHomology. Lean quotient argument written by T2.
